Tests that setting a breakpoint deoptimizes inlined functions.
Checking optimization status before breakpoint:
f1 isOptimized: true
f2 isOptimized: true
f3 isOptimized: true
Checking optimization status after breakpoint in f1:
f1 isOptimized: false
f2 isOptimized: true
f3 isOptimized: false
Optimizing f4 with breakpoint set:
f4 isOptimized: true
